project.name: nhatrovn-assistant
project.description: Nhatrovn Assistant - read-only AI chatbot for the Vietnamese room rental marketplace nhatro.vn. Search, refine, compare, cost estimate, FAQ, summarize, find similar. Strictly read-only: never books, messages, holds, pays, or edits.

nodes.name: Frontend HTML
nodes.summary: Material-styled chat UI. Tailwind via CDN. Vietnamese/English aware header.

nodes.name: Frontend WebSocket Client
nodes.summary: Browser controller. WebSocket + session sidebar + reconnect logic.

nodes.name: Brand Logo
nodes.summary: Brand logo image (3 KB).

nodes.name: Rust Gateway Entry Point
nodes.summary: Actix Web server. Wires SQLite, Qdrant, Kafka, CORS, tracing, and serves the static frontend at /.

nodes.name: AppConfig
nodes.summary: Loads host/port, Kafka brokers, Qdrant URL/API key, env settings via dotenvy.

nodes.name: Error Types
nodes.summary: Shared error enums and From conversions.

nodes.name: WebSocket /ws/chat
nodes.summary: WebSocket handler. Forwards question to Kafka query.request and pumps query.response tokens back to client.

nodes.name: Health Check
nodes.summary: Liveness endpoint.

nodes.name: Chat History REST
nodes.summary: REST API: list/fetch/delete chat sessions backed by SQLite. Source of truth for the frontend sidebar.

nodes.name: SQLite Database Service
nodes.summary: SQLite connection + schema migrations for the chat_history table.

nodes.name: Kafka Service
nodes.summary: rdkafka producer + response consumer. Background task forwards query.response to the right WebSocket by session_id.

nodes.name: Qdrant Service
nodes.summary: Thin Qdrant client wrapper used at startup to verify connectivity.

nodes.name: Kafka Topics Config
nodes.summary: Topic names, group ids, brokers, and serialize/deserialize helpers used by both workers.

nodes.name: Query Worker (Kafka Consumer)
nodes.summary: Consumes query.request events, pre-warms models, runs the room assistant, publishes each token to query.response, and emits the final grounded answer. 2-min timeout, graceful shutdown.

nodes.name: Listing Index Worker
nodes.summary: Consumes listing.changed events, fetches the latest listing from Mongo, embeds it with BAAI/bge-m3, and upserts/deletes the corresponding Qdrant point. Permanent/retry-exhausted failures go to listing.index.dlq.

nodes.name: Domain Schemas
nodes.summary: 10 read-only Intents, 7 read-only tools, operation paths (location, budget, occupants, vehicles, pets, amenities), session state shape, and the listing normalization contract. Strong room-rental semantics: districts/wards, rent_price, deposit, area_m2, electric_bike_allowed, pets_allowed.

nodes.name: Intent Parser
nodes.summary: Two-tier intent + constraint-patch parser. ~85% matched by deterministic regex over Vietnamese keywords (tim phong, so sanh, tinh tien, tuong tu, dat lich, etc.). Remaining cases fall back to a small LLM JSON call. Strictly read-only.

nodes.name: Read-Only Tool Registry
nodes.summary: Implements the 7 read-only tools (search_listings, get_listing_detail, retrieve_listing_context, retrieve_faq, calculate_cost_estimate, compare_listings, find_similar_listings) and enforces write_tool_calls_per_turn=0 / max_read_tool_calls_per_turn<=3.

nodes.name: Listing Repository
nodes.summary: Protocol + three implementations: EmptyListingRepository (no-data fallback), InMemoryListingRepository (tests), MongoListingRepository (production). Mongo query builder maps the room-rental constraints to indexed filters with Vietnamese-aware district normalization.

nodes.name: Session State Store
nodes.summary: SessionStore Protocol with InMemorySessionStore and RedisSessionStore (Upstash REST). Validated apply_operations supports set/remove/append/replace/clear on whitelisted constraint paths.

nodes.name: Room Assistant Workflow
nodes.summary: Main orchestrator. Production flow: normalize_input -> parse_intent_async -> analyze_mood -> load_session_state -> merge_and_validate_state -> route_workflow -> execute_read_only_tools -> grounding_check -> compose_answer_with_review -> persist_state_and_trace -> END.

nodes.name: Hybrid Retrieval
nodes.summary: search_listings_with_hard_filters: enforces Mongo/in-memory hard constraints FIRST, then re-ranks with Qdrant semantic search. Authoritative results are always re-fetched from the repository to avoid serving stale vectors.

nodes.name: Listing Indexing Service
nodes.summary: Continuous indexing contract. build_canonical_embedding_text combines title/description/space_features/amenities/neighborhood/rules/highlights into a Vietnamese-aware canonical text. Handles upsert/delete/publish/unpublish, content-hash dedup, version skipping, retry/backoff, DLQ on permanent errors.

nodes.name: Qdrant Listing Index Adapters
nodes.summary: Adapters that implement ListingSemanticIndex and ListingVectorIndex Protocols on top of QdrantWrapper. Used both for serving search and for the indexing worker.

nodes.name: Graph Entry Point
nodes.summary: Compatibility entry point. Production flow goes straight into room_assistant.workflow.run_room_assistant. The legacy support graph is intentionally NOT imported here.

nodes.name: Interaction Router
nodes.summary: Classifies the user message into SEARCH/QUESTION/CASUAL using fast Vietnamese keyword lists and embedding-similarity centroids. Domain seeds explicitly mention nhatro.vn room queries.

nodes.name: Response Writer
nodes.summary: Builds the final Vietnamese response with mood-aware tone (frustrated/urgent/normal). Strict rules: only verified data, never invent prices, never promise booking/messaging/payment. Groq Smart primary, Groq Fast fallback.

nodes.name: Answer Reviewer
nodes.summary: Reviews the candidate answer against verified data to catch hallucinations, missing sources, and unverified claims before persistence.

nodes.name: Query Rewriter
nodes.summary: Rewrites a user query when the first retrieval returns empty. Bounded retries (MAX_REWRITE_RETRIES=2) before giving up.

nodes.name: Mood / Sentiment Analyzer
nodes.summary: Embedding-based mood detector (frustrated/urgent/normal). Zero LLM tokens, used to tune the response tone.

nodes.name: Agent State Helpers
nodes.summary: Helpers for the LangGraph state object used by the legacy support flow. Not on the production read-only path.

nodes.name: Retrieval Grader
nodes.summary: Scores retrieved chunks against the user query against GRADE_SCORE_THRESHOLD=0.15.

nodes.name: LLM Client
nodes.summary: Groq/Vertex AI HTTP client with rate limiting, timeouts, retries, and JSON parsing helpers used by router/rewriter/response_writer/reviewer.

nodes.name: Model Registry (Singletons)
nodes.summary: Loads BAAI/bge-m3 and BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3 once. Selects CUDA fp16 vs CPU fp32 based on free VRAM. warmup() is called by the query worker to avoid cold-start latency.

nodes.name: Qdrant Wrapper
nodes.summary: Qdrant collection management + dense + BM25 sparse hybrid vectors. Stop-words cover both English and Vietnamese function words. Used by both serving and indexing paths.

nodes.name: Hybrid Search RRF
nodes.summary: Reciprocal Rank Fusion over dense + sparse vectors. RRF_DENSE_WEIGHT=0.6 / RRF_SPARSE_WEIGHT=0.4 / RRF_K=60.

nodes.name: Reranker
nodes.summary: BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3 wrapper used to rerank top-K results before final answer generation.

nodes.name: Answer Cache
nodes.summary: Upstash Redis cache for static FAQ / non-dynamic answers. Dynamic listing answers are OFF by default (ENABLE_DYNAMIC_LISTING_ANSWER_CACHE=false).

nodes.name: Project Config
nodes.summary: Loads .env, defines EMBEDDING_MODEL, KAFKA_BROKERS, QDRANT_URL, MONGO_URI, REDIS, Langfuse, RRF, and listing-index retry settings.

nodes.name: Rich Console
nodes.summary: Shared rich Console singleton for pretty CLI logs.

nodes.name: Langfuse Observability
nodes.summary: Langfuse tracing wrapper for LLM calls and indexing events.

nodes.name: DPO/SFT Training Pipeline
nodes.summary: Four-stage LLM training data pipeline: merge+clean DPO data, edge-case augmentation, DPO->SFT conversion, and train/dev/test split. Used to fine-tune the LLM that powers the room assistant. NOT on the request-time production path.

nodes.name: Policy Loader
nodes.summary: Loads and chunks the MyKingdom policy JSON into per-section embeddings. NOTE: leftover from a previous (MyKingdom children-products) chatbot. NOT used by the production room assistant flow.

nodes.name: RAG Augmentation
nodes.summary: Gemini 2.5 Flash augmentation of MyKingdom policies into JSONL for retrieval-style training. Same legacy scope as policy_loader.py.

nodes.name: Text Chunker
nodes.summary: Section-aware chunker used by policy_loader for training data.

nodes.name: DPO Prompts
nodes.summary: Six customer-service scenarios with chosen/rejected response rules used for DPO training data synthesis.

nodes.name: Data Processing Utils
nodes.summary: JSON loaders, sanitizers, and Gemini client wrapper used by the training pipeline.

nodes.name: Backfill Listings
nodes.summary: Iterates every listing in the repository and either (a) publishes a listing.changed Kafka event (mode=events) or (b) indexes directly into Qdrant (mode=direct). Supports --dry-run, --resume, and a JSON checkpoint file.

nodes.name: Docker Compose
nodes.summary: Local stack: Qdrant 1.9.7, Redpanda 24.1.9 (Kafka API on 9092), Redpanda Console on 8888, Mongo 7.0. Persistent volumes.

nodes.name: Env Example
nodes.summary: Template for HOST/PORT, KAFKA, QDRANT, Mongo, Redis, Langfuse, Vertex. LLM/observability keys are optional - the system has read-only and in-memory fallbacks.

nodes.name: Rust Cargo Manifest
nodes.summary: actix-web 4, actix-ws 0.3, rdkafka 0.36 with cmake-build, qdrant-client 1, rusqlite 0.31 (bundled), tracing, dotenvy.

nodes.name: Python Requirements
nodes.summary: Core ML: torch, sentence-transformers, qdrant-client, confluent-kafka, pymongo. LLM: aiohttp, tiktoken, tenacity. AI: langgraph, langchain-core. Observability: langfuse. Caching: upstash-redis. Training: datasets, google-cloud-aiplatform.

nodes.name: Project README
nodes.summary: Documents the Nhatrovn read-only room assistant: architecture, production flow, read-only tool registry, invariants, session state, event schema, Qdrant schema, and local setup.

nodes.name: Room Assistant Core Tests
nodes.summary: Unit tests for intent parsing, budget parsing, session patch + remove operations, in-memory session TTL, repository constraints, and the read-only tool registry budget.

nodes.name: Workflow Indexing Tests
nodes.summary: Integration tests for workflow + listing indexing + version skipping + DLQ paths.

nodes.name: Read-Only Invariant
nodes.summary: Hard project invariant: write_tool_calls_per_turn=0 and max_read_tool_calls_per_turn<=3. Enforced by ReadOnlyToolRegistry. Any tool that mutates a listing, session, booking, or payment is explicitly out of scope.

nodes.name: Grounded Answer
nodes.summary: Final response generation only uses data fetched by the read-only tools. The response_writer and reviewer re-validate the answer against the verified context before persistence.

nodes.name: Room Rental Domain (nhatro.vn)
nodes.summary: The product is centered on finding a room to rent in Vietnam. Core entities: Listing (rent_price, deposit, district, ward, amenities, pets_allowed, electric_bike_allowed, area_m2). Core actions: search / refine / ask / cost / compare / similar / summarize / FAQ. Hard NO actions: booking, messaging landlord, holding, payment, edit listing, negotiation.

nodes.name: Listing Change Event Flow
nodes.summary: listing.changed Kafka event with operation in {upsert, delete, publish, unpublish} is consumed by the index worker, which fetches the authoritative listing from Mongo, embeds it, and upserts/deletes the corresponding Qdrant point. Permanent failures go to listing.index.dlq.

layers.name: Frontend (Chat UI)
layers.description: Browser chat interface served as static files. Connects to the Rust WebSocket and renders streamed tokens, sources, suggested questions, and a sessions sidebar.

layers.name: Rust Gateway (Actix + Kafka + SQLite)
layers.description: Stateless WebSocket/REST gateway. Bridges the browser to Kafka (query.request) and pumps streamed responses back. Persists session history to SQLite.

layers.name: Kafka Workers (Transport Boundary)
layers.description: Bridge between Kafka and the Python AI core. The query worker runs the room assistant. The listing index worker keeps Qdrant in sync with Mongo.

layers.name: Room Assistant (Read-Only Domain Core)
layers.description: Strictly read-only production domain logic for nhatro.vn. Implements the read-only tool registry, intent parser, session state, repository, hybrid retrieval, and workflow.

layers.name: Shared AI / Agents
layers.description: Cross-cutting AI components: LLM client, model registry, router, mood analyzer, response writer, reviewer, and rewriter. All callers go through the room assistant workflow.

layers.name: Retrieval & Caching Infrastructure
layers.description: Vector store, hybrid search, reranker, and answer cache. Used by both the room assistant (serving) and the index worker (writes).

layers.name: Config and Utilities
layers.description: Project-wide config and small utility modules (rich console, Langfuse observability).

layers.name: Training Data Pipeline (Legacy / Off-Path)
layers.description: DPO/SFT data preparation for the LLM. References a MyKingdom children-products policy set; this is NOT on the production request-time path and is a leftover from an earlier project.

layers.name: Scripts, Tests, and Infrastructure
layers.description: Backfill scripts, unit tests, docker-compose stack, and the project README.

tour.title: Project overview
tour.description: Nhatrovn Assistant is a strictly read-only AI chatbot for the Vietnamese room-rental marketplace nhatro.vn. It can search, refine, compare, estimate cost, and answer FAQs about listings. It must NEVER book, message landlords, hold rooms, accept payments, or edit listings.

tour.title: End-to-end request flow
tour.description: Frontend WebSocket -> Rust gateway (Kafka publish to query.request) -> Python query worker -> room_assistant.workflow (intent -> session -> tools -> grounding -> answer) -> Kafka publish to query.response -> Rust streams tokens back to the browser.

tour.title: Domain core (room_assistant)
tour.description: All read-only domain logic. The Intent enum, the 7 read-only tools, the session state, the listing repository (Mongo/in-memory/empty), and hybrid retrieval that always re-validates from the source of truth.

tour.title: Continuous indexing pipeline
tour.description: External crawlers publish listing.changed events to Kafka. The index worker fetches the latest listing from Mongo, embeds it with BAAI/bge-m3, and upserts/deletes the corresponding Qdrant point. Permanent/retry-exhausted failures go to listing.index.dlq. scripts/backfill_listings.py replays the same flow on demand.

tour.title: Local infrastructure and tests
tour.description: docker-compose brings up Qdrant, Redpanda (Kafka API), and Mongo. SQLite lives inside the Rust gateway. Tests cover the intent parser, budget parsing, repository constraints, the read-only tool budget, and the indexing/version/DLQ paths.
